intro.text: An Alethi Shardbearer who fought on the Shattered Plains.

items.text: Kalishor had Shardplate but no Blade. Since none of the full Shardbearers would accept his challenge, Adolin Kholin thought of challenging Kalishor, expecting him to want the fame and Adolin's Shards, but Kalishor seems to have refused as well.
